401928532.blurb: Badajoz have won their last two after three straight defeats, and they host a Tenerife side without a win in five (three draws, two losses). It's a one-off knockout where the visitors' slump could open the door.

401928506.blurb: Calvo Sotelo get a first-round shot at Albacete, who have lost four straight after a draw. A single-leg tie gives the hosts a real opening against a visitor badly short of form.

401928511.blurb: Amateur side Covadonga welcome Real Valladolid, who have lost just once in their last five with two wins. The visitors are clear favorites on paper in this one-off first-round knockout.

401928528.blurb: Mijas Las Lagunas host Real Jaén in a first-round cup tie. Jaén snapped a four-match losing run with a win last time out and will hope to build on it against modest opposition.

401928490.blurb: Historic Numancia face Real Oviedo in one of the round's more established pairings. Both sides have mixed form — Numancia two wins in five, Oviedo two wins and a draw — making it a fairly open one-off tie.

401928550.blurb: Madrid-area minnows Trival Valderas host Leganés, who ended a three-game losing streak with a win last time. A first-round upset chance against a visitor still searching for consistency.

401921834.blurb: A last-16 knockout between two in-form Premier League sides: Brighton arrive with four wins and a draw in their last five, while City have won three of five. One leg, with a quarterfinal place on the line.

401928524.blurb: A Murcia-region derby flavor: CD Minera, winners of their last two, host FC Cartagena, who have won two of five. The hosts' momentum meets a higher-tier visitor in a single-leg knockout.

401928530.blurb: A classic Copa del Rey mismatch on paper: Granada arrive with three wins in their last five against a Cieza side with only two recorded results. The first-round format gives the small club a single shot at an upset.

401928517.blurb: Gimnástica Torrelavega carry a five-game losing run into this first-round cup tie, while UD Ourense's only recorded result is also a loss. One side gets a reset and a place in the next round.

401928500.blurb: Barakaldo's alternating form (two wins, three losses in five) meets a Reus FC Reddis side that split its two recorded games. It's a low-profile, single-leg first-round tie where either club can advance.

401874988.blurb: Ninth-place Juventus, unbeaten in their last two, visit 17th-place Genoa. The hosts have one win in seven league games but just two losses in their last five, so this is a chance for Juve to climb and a test of Genoa's resilience near the drop zone.

401874799.blurb: Napoli sit 10th with one win in their last five and visit 14th-place Monza, whose Varela has seven league goals, more than double De Bruyne's team-leading three. This midweek trip could help Napoli steady a stuttering start.

401917033.blurb: Leverkusen bring four straight wins into this second-round Pokal tie, while Nürnberg are unbeaten in five, with three draws. The knockout format means the Bundesliga side needs to impose itself against a stubborn visitor.

401917035.blurb: Bayern's form is uneven, with three draws in their last five, as they host Magdeburg in a single-elimination Pokal tie. The visitors have lost just once in five, so a home stumble would be costly in a competition with no second chance.

401921840.blurb: An all-Premier League fourth-round tie: Aston Villa are unbeaten in five with three wins, while Bournemouth have lost two straight after three games without defeat. A quarterfinal place is on the line in a one-off knockout.

401921841.blurb: A London derby for a Carabao Cup quarterfinal spot. Fulham have one loss in five but only one win, and Crystal Palace have one win in five, so both clubs could use a cup run to lift their form.

401921843.blurb: Brentford are unbeaten in five, with two straight wins, as they visit a Sunderland side that has lost three of its last four. The fourth-round tie offers the hosts a chance to break that slide and reach the last eight.

401916922.blurb: Two traditional German clubs meet in a second-round knockout. Hannover have won only one of their last five, while Kaiserslautern arrive having won two of their last three.

401917034.blurb: Bundesliga side Hoffenheim have lost three straight, which gives cup-tie hosts Holstein Kiel an opening. Kiel are still looking for a win in their last five (DLDLD).

401878355.blurb: Leaders Celtic have 24 points from nine league games, but they have lost two of their last five. Benjamin Nygren has six goals. Sixth-place Dundee United, half Celtic's points total on 12, have only one loss in five.

401878356.blurb: Seventh-place Aberdeen have won their last two and lead Falkirk by two points. Top scorers Kevin Nisbet and J. Murrell have four goals apiece in this mid-table matchup.

401878354.blurb: Fourth-place Dundee can strengthen their grip on the top half against 11th-place Kilmarnock, who have lost five of nine league games and sit six points behind.

401878352.blurb: Fifth-place St Johnstone, led by six-goal J. Fowler, host a Motherwell side on a four-match losing streak and four points behind them in 10th.

401878351.blurb: Bottom-placed Hibernian, on seven points, visit a St Mirren side that has lost four straight. Only three points separate eighth from 12th, so this is a meaningful lower-table clash.

401921842.blurb: Two Premier League heavyweights meet in a fourth-round knockout, so one big name exits the Carabao Cup. Both arrive with three wins in their last five, with Chelsea's form (WWLDW) slightly steadier than Liverpool's (DWWLW).

401916997.blurb: Arsenal are unbeaten in this league phase but have won just one of their last five overall. Benfica, a point behind in 10th, have lost four of five, with M. Bratberg Lund scoring both of their league-phase goals.

401916996.blurb: Second-place OL Lyonnes and sixth-place Inter are level on four points after two league-phase games. Marie-Antoinette Katoto has three goals for Lyon, who are unbeaten in their last five (DWDWW).

401928551.blurb: A classic Copa del Rey first-round mismatch: Navalcarnero arrive having lost four of their last five, while Betis bring a steadier run of two wins and two draws. This is the hosts' chance at a giant-killing.

401928487.blurb: Salamanca, split one win and one loss in their limited recent sample, try to topple Celta, who have two wins, two draws and one loss in their last five. It's a one-off cup tie where an upset is possible.

401928504.blurb: A local cup occasion for Tavernes de la Valldigna, unbeaten in two draws, against a Valencia side with one win in their last five. The visitors will want to avoid an embarrassing first-round slip.

401928548.blurb: An Andalusian cup tie pits struggling Xerez, losers of four of their last five, against Cádiz, who have one win in five. Neither side arrives in form, giving this regional meeting an open feel.

401878353.blurb: Second hosts third... with Rangers visiting. Rangers come in on four straight wins and lead third-place Hearts by four points. A home win would pull Hearts within one, while Rangers can stretch the gap to seven.

401841293.blurb: Second-place Palmeiras, on four straight wins with just three league losses all season, visit eighth-place Santos in a São Paulo state rivalry. Gabriel Barbosa's 15 goals give Santos a real threat.

401841289.blurb: Internacional sit 17th in the relegation zone on 32 points but have two wins in their last three. Fifth-place Fluminense need a response after three straight losses before their latest win.

401841291.blurb: Bottom-placed Chapecoense have only three wins all season and sit 23 points behind 10th-place Bragantino. The hosts have dropped their last two and need a reset against the league's weakest record.

761908.blurb: Lionel Messi, with 25 goals, leads second-place Miami against a Cincinnati side clinging to eighth after three losses in their last five. Kévin Denkey's 17 goals give the visitors a dangerous outlet.

761907.blurb: Fifth-place Charlotte can firm up their East position at home to last-place Montréal, who have 17 losses. Idan Toklomati's 13 goals face Prince Owusu, whose 15 are a rare bright spot for the visitors.

761909.blurb: Third-place New England (52 pts) look to protect a top-three spot against a Red Bulls side sitting ninth on 36 points. New York arrive level on points with 10th-place Toronto, so every point matters. Carles Gil (12) and Julian Hall (11) lead the scoring.

761905.blurb: Two clubs in the lower reaches of the East meet: NYCFC are 12th with one win in their last five, Atlanta 14th on 30 points. Nicolás Fernández's 15 goals for New York contrast with an Atlanta attack whose top scorer, Aleksei Miranchuk, has just six.

761906.blurb: Toronto sit 10th on 36 points, level with ninth-place New York, so a home win over 13th-place D.C. United could matter. D.C.'s Christian Benteke-less attack runs through Jacob Murrell-free leader Tai Baribo, whose 16 goals double Dávid Sallói's eight.

761910.blurb: Real Salt Lake sit 10th in the West on 36 points and need results from this trip. Austin are 14th, winless in their last five with three draws. Samuel Solans has 12 goals for RSL; Cristian Ramírez leads Austin with nine.

761911.blurb: Fourth-place Chicago (48 pts) have three wins in their last five and host seventh-place Orlando, who are seven points back. Orlando's Martín Ojeda has 15 goals against Maren Haile-Selassie's 11, setting up an intriguing contest of attacking midfielders.

761912.blurb: Petar Musa's 20 goals have powered FC Dallas to third in the West on 51 points. Columbus, 11th in the East on 35, have three wins in their last five but no player beyond five league goals, making this a test of Dallas's firepower against a balanced Crew.

761913.blurb: Minnesota, 13th in the West and winless in five, host last-place Sporting Kansas City (22 pts, 20 losses). Kelvin Yeboah's 17 goals are the clearest edge for the Loons against a Sporting side led by André Luiz's seven.

761914.blurb: East leaders Nashville (67 pts, 20-7-3) host a Philadelphia side that also enters with four wins in their last five. Sam Surridge (17) and Milan Iloski (19) headline a meeting of two of the conference's most in-form teams.

761915.blurb: Second-place St. Louis (51 pts) are level with Dallas and host a Portland side 11th in the West and winless in five. A home win would help City hold a top-two position against opponents who have badly lost their way.

401841296.blurb: Seventh-place Bahia (49 pts) host ninth-place São Paulo in a mid-table clash between two sides with identical recent form. Luciano Juba and Jonathan Calleri each have 10 goals, and Bahia can stretch a seven-point cushion over the Tricolor.

401841297.blurb: Remo sit 19th on 26 points and are winless in five, with four straight draws before their last loss. Points against 11th-place Botafogo, who snapped a skid with a win, are vital in the relegation fight.

761917.blurb: Fourth-place San Jose, led by Preston Judd's 16 goals, host a Colorado side clinging to ninth, the West's last playoff place. The Rapids have one win in their last five, all draws but one loss.

761916.blurb: Seattle arrive on three straight wins and sit 7th, five points behind fifth-place Houston. The Dynamo have gone five without a win but carry Guilherme Augusto's 16 goals, so playoff positioning is on the line.

761918.blurb: West leaders Vancouver hold a seven-point cushion but are winless in five. San Diego sit 12th, five points below ninth-place Colorado, and need results to stay in the playoff hunt, while Brian White chases more goals.

401876986.blurb: Leaders América, beaten once in 12 league games, host 11th-place Tijuana, who have one win in their last five. Xolos need points to climb toward the playoff places, while América protect top spot.
